# temps_ai_provider (Resource)

An upstream model provider of the Temps AI gateway (OpenAI, Anthropic, a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server, ...) with its API key. Enable or add models with `temps_ai_provider_model`.

Import with `<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `ai_gateway:read`, `ai_gateway:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_ai_provider" "openai" {
  provider_type = "openai"
  display_name  = "OpenAI"
  api_key       = var.openai_api_key
  default_model = "gpt-4o-mini"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the console.
- `provider_type` (String) Provider kind, for example `openai`, `anthropic` or `openai_compatible`.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Provider API key. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `base_url` (String) API base URL, for self-hosted or proxied providers.
- `capabilities` (String) What a self-hosted provider supports (chat, embeddings, tools, ...). A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `default_model` (String) Model used when a request names none.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Route requests to the provider.
- `trust_private_address` (Boolean) Allow `base_url` to resolve to a private network address. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `api_key_masked` (String) The stored key, masked.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id>
terraform import temps_ai_provider.openai 5
```
